title: Read link annotations and named destinations through pdfxi links
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-core --lib links and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi links resolves URI, explicit and named destinations on the real annotation fixture and on a generated document with all three kinds; VIEW-011 moves to verified. VIEW-009 stays model until embedded bytes can be opened or saved.
notes: Adds a permissive interactive-layer reader: link annotations with /A /URI, /A /GoTo, /Dest arrays and named destinations from /Dests and the /Names /Dests tree, plus the attachment listing used by pdfxi attachments. Malformed annotations are skipped and unresolved destinations are reported by name.
